# Commands

Every command takes `--json` (and `--sarif` where shown) for machine output. Exit codes: `0` clean, `1` violations, `2` tool error.

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`aact init`](#aact-init) | Create aact.config.ts and a starter architecture file |
| [`aact check`](#aact-check) | Check architecture rules |
| [`aact analyze`](#aact-analyze) | Analyze architecture metrics |
| [`aact model`](#aact-model) | Print the normalized Model (text summary, --json for full graph, --sarif for issues) |
| [`aact diff`](#aact-diff) | Show structural diff between two architecture models (PR review) |
| [`aact view`](#aact-view) | Open the local architecture workbench in a browser (requires @aact/view) |
| [`aact generate`](#aact-generate) | Generate architecture artifacts |
| [`aact rule`](#aact-rule) | Inspect and manage architecture rules |
| [`aact skill`](#aact-skill) | Install agent skills for aact workflows |

## `aact init`

Create aact.config.ts and a starter architecture file

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | boolean | Emit JSON envelope on stdout (machine-readable for CI / agents) |

## `aact check`

Check architecture rules

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | Path to aact config file (defaults to c12 auto-discovery from cwd) |
| `--json` | boolean | Emit JSON envelope on stdout (machine-readable for CI / agents) |
| `--sarif` | boolean | Emit SARIF v2.1.0 on stdout (uploadable to GitHub Code Scanning, SonarQube, etc.). Outranks --json if both are set. |
| `--fix` | boolean | Apply auto-fixes to the source file |
| `--dry-run` | boolean | Show fixes without applying them (exits 1 if violations exist) |

## `aact diff`

Show structural diff between two architecture models (PR review)

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<baseline>` | positional | Baseline source: file path, directory (kubernetes), `<ref>:<path>` git ref, or `-` for stdin |
| `<current>` | positional, optional | Current source — file path or directory (defaults to aact.config.ts → source when omitted) |
| `--baseline-format` | string | Override format detection for baseline (plantuml, structurizr, model-json, kubernetes, compose) |
| `--current-format` | string | Override format detection for current (plantuml, structurizr, model-json, kubernetes, compose) |
| `--strict` | boolean | Exit 1 on cosmetic-only changes (default: cosmetic = 0) |
| `--with-patch` | boolean | Include RFC 6902 patch[] in the JSON envelope (opt-in) |
| `--rename-threshold` | string | Similarity threshold for rename detection in [0,1] (default 0.65) |
| `--no-rename-detection` | boolean | Disable rename heuristic; surface as pure add/remove |
| `--config` | string | Path to aact config file (defaults to c12 auto-discovery from cwd) |
| `--json` | boolean | Emit JSON envelope on stdout (machine-readable for CI / agents) |

## `aact view`

Open the local architecture workbench in a browser (requires @aact/view)

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | Path to aact config file (defaults to c12 auto-discovery from cwd) |
| `--port` | string | Port to bind the workbench server (default: auto-pick) |
| `--no-open` | boolean | Print the URL instead of auto-opening a browser (CI / headless) |
| `--diff` | string | Baseline for diff mode (file path, git ref `main:arch.dsl`, or `-` for stdin). Workbench shows the architectural diff on top of the current model. |
| `--diff-format` | string | Format hint for the diff baseline (required for stdin or non-canonical extensions) |

## `aact skill`

Install agent skills for aact workflows

### `aact skill install`

Install the community aact-architect skill for AI agents

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | boolean | Emit JSON envelope on stdout (machine-readable for CI / agents) |
| `--client` | enum | Client target: shared, codex, cursor, copilot, claude, cline, all |
| `--codex` | boolean | Install into the shared ~/.agents/skills path used by Codex |
| `--cursor` | boolean | Install into the shared ~/.agents/skills path used by Cursor |
| `--copilot` | boolean | Install into the shared ~/.agents/skills path used by GitHub Copilot |
| `--claude` | boolean | Install into ~/.claude/skills for Claude Code |
| `--cline` | boolean | Install into ~/.cline/skills for Cline |
| `--all` | boolean | Install shared, Claude Code, and Cline targets |
| `--target` | string | Custom skills root or full skill directory |
| `--repo` | string | Skill repository URL |
| `--ref` | string | Git branch or tag to install |
| `--force` | boolean | Overwrite an existing unmanaged skill directory |
| `--dry-run` | boolean | Show target directories without writing files |
